_README: Cup games (FA Cup / Carabao) and manual score corrections live here, because no free feed covers English cups. Add entries to the 'fixtures' list below.
_how_to: BEFORE a cup tie (so players can predict it): add it with "status": "SCHEDULED" and null scores. Add it a few days ahead.
AFTER it is played: set "status": "FINISHED" and fill home_score / away_score.
To CORRECT a Premier League score the feed got wrong: add an entry whose "id" is that game's id — it overrides the feed.
id: any unique whole number >= 9000000 for cup games. home/away: the display names you want shown (e.g. Spurs, Man Utd, Liverpool). group_label: the scorecard heading.
